discoveries.title: Assumed Initial Business Problem
discoveries.discovery: The railway currently suffers from inefficient and siloed incident management processes, leading to delayed responses, poor real-time communication with passengers, increased operational costs, and diminished customer satisfaction during disruptions.
discoveries.source_basis: The Product Owner inferred this core business problem based on the product name and common railway challenges since no initial business problem description was provided.
discoveries.open_question: What is the official baseline business problem description for SmartRail?

discoveries.title: Real-time Incident Reporting and Logging
discoveries.discovery: Authorised personnel such as train drivers, station staff, and the control centre need the ability to log incidents with location, type, severity, and initial observations.
discoveries.source_basis: Listed under essential capabilities for solving the assumed problem.

discoveries.title: Incident Status and Lifecycle Management
discoveries.discovery: The system must track incidents from reported to resolved, including stages like investigation, action taken, and resolution.
discoveries.source_basis: Mentioned as an essential capability to track incident progress.

discoveries.title: Internal Notification and Alerting System
discoveries.discovery: Automatically alert relevant operational teams such as control, maintenance, customer service, and train crew based on incident type and severity.
discoveries.source_basis: Identified as a core essential capability.
discoveries.open_question: What are the precise triggers, recipients, and escalation paths for different incident types and severities?

discoveries.title: Basic Passenger Information Dissemination
discoveries.discovery: Broadcast standardised, accurate delay and cancellation messages to passengers via multiple channels like station displays, app notifications, and website updates.
discoveries.source_basis: Listed as an essential capability for passenger communication.
discoveries.open_question: What specific channels are included and what level of detail is provided?

discoveries.title: Basic Resource Allocation for Operational Staff
discoveries.discovery: Provide a simple mechanism to assign immediate tasks or personnel to an ongoing incident, such as sending a maintenance crew to a specific location.
discoveries.source_basis: Described as an essential capability for managing operational staff during incidents.

discoveries.title: Operational Dashboard and Reporting
discoveries.discovery: A high-level view of active incidents, their status, and basic performance metrics for operational managers.
discoveries.source_basis: Listed as an essential operational capability.

discoveries.title: Additional Operational and Support Actors
discoveries.discovery: Potential missing actors include Train Drivers/Onboard Staff, Station Staff/Ground Crew, Maintenance & Engineering Teams, Customer Service/Call Centre Agents, Regulatory Authorities, Emergency Services, and Public Relations/Corporate Communications.
discoveries.source_basis: Identified by the Product Owner as important missing actors.

discoveries.title: Emergency Response and Governance Processes
discoveries.discovery: Processes concerning emergency response protocols, data validation, post-incident analysis, staff training, and integration with ticketing, scheduling, and asset management systems need to be established.

discoveries.title: Definition of Real-time Latency
discoveries.discovery: The exact acceptable latency for incident reporting and updates (whether seconds or minutes) is unspecified.
discoveries.source_basis: Highlighted in the ambiguous requirements section.
discoveries.open_question: What is the acceptable latency for incident reporting and updates?

discoveries.title: Legacy System Integration Scope
discoveries.discovery: It is unclear which existing railway systems SmartRail must integrate with initially and whether the integration should be read-only or read-write.
discoveries.source_basis: Highlighted as a major architectural ambiguity.
discoveries.open_question: Which existing railway systems must SmartRail integrate with initially and to what extent?

discoveries.title: Full AI-Powered Predictive Maintenance
discoveries.discovery: Building sophisticated AI models for predictive maintenance from scratch requires vast data and time, and is considered too large for an initial release focused on response.
discoveries.source_basis: Identified as a stakeholder request that may unnecessarily expand scope and should be challenged.

discoveries.title: Personalised Passenger Journey Planning and Re-routing
discoveries.discovery: Real-time journey planning, alternative transport options, and individual passenger profile integration are highly complex tasks going beyond core incident response.
discoveries.source_basis: Listed as a scope candidate to challenge for the initial release.

discoveries.title: Comprehensive CRM for Passenger Loyalty Programs
discoveries.discovery: Building a full customer relationship management system is an entirely separate product initiative from incident management.
discoveries.source_basis: Identified as a scope expansion candidate.

discoveries.title: Dynamic Pricing and Automated Compensation Calculations
discoveries.discovery: Automated compensation and dynamic pricing involve complex financial systems with significant regulatory and audit implications.
discoveries.source_basis: Listed as a feature that should be excluded from core incident response scope.

discoveries.title: End-to-End Asset Management System
discoveries.discovery: SmartRail should interface with asset management for context, but building a brand new full asset management system is out of scope.
discoveries.source_basis: Highlighted as a scope candidate to be deferred or excluded from core product.

discoveries.title: MVP Capabilities Definition
discoveries.discovery: The MVP should include core incident reporting, status tracking, internal communication module, standardised passenger alerts, basic user roles, and a centralised dashboard with basic read-only integration points.
discoveries.source_basis: Described as capabilities that belong strictly in the MVP.

discoveries.title: Deferred Capabilities for Post-MVP Phases
discoveries.discovery: Advanced analytics, comprehensive resource optimisation, personalised passenger communication, emergency service integration, automated compensation processing, mobile apps for all roles, and two-way feedback can be deferred.
discoveries.source_basis: Listed as features that could reasonably be deferred to subsequent phases.

discoveries.title: Unanswered Implementation Questions
discoveries.discovery: Several critical questions regarding KPIs, definition of an incident, legacy integration requirements, target users, budget, timeline, regulatory compliance, change management, and data ownership remain unanswered.
discoveries.source_basis: Highlighted as important questions that must be answered before implementation.
discoveries.open_question: What are the primary KPIs, definition of an incident, legacy system dependencies, budget, timeline, and regulatory constraints?
